## Identity

FirstStep Junk Removal LLC (also known as First Step Junk Removal) is a junk removal service based in Rockford, Illinois. Website: https://firststepjunk.com. Phone: (779) 772-1857. Email: firststep.junk@gmail.com.

## Services

Junk removal, debris removal, dumpster rental, waste management, garbage collection, furniture removal, appliance removal, electronics recycling, estate cleanouts, office cleanouts, construction debris, yard waste, residential and commercial hauling. Non-hazardous materials only. Licensed and insured. Same-day pickup available when schedule allows. Upfront pricing — the quote is the price paid.

## Pricing

Owner-set flat rates, based on how much of the 10 ft x 6 ft dump trailer (4 ft walls) the junk fills. Junk removal starts at $90. Every rate includes labor, pickup, hauling, and all dump fees.

- Small load: $90-$125
- 1/4 load: $150
- 1/2 load: $250
- 3/4 load: $350
- Full load: $425 flat
- Shed demolition: $725 flat for a standard empty wood 10x12 shed (demolition, hauling, disposal; concrete slab quoted separately)
- Mattresses and box springs: extra, landfill fee is separate

Free estimates by phone, text, or website form with optional photos; the price is confirmed before work starts.

## FAQ (verbatim)

Q: How much does junk removal cost in Rockford, IL?
A: Junk removal in Rockford starts at $90. Pricing is by how much of our 10×6 ft trailer your junk fills: small load $90–$125, 1/4 load $150, 1/2 load $250, 3/4 load $350, and a full load is a $425 flat rate. Every rate includes labor, pickup, hauling, and all dump fees. Mattresses and box springs are extra because the landfill fee is separate. Call or text (779) 772-1857, or send photos through the quote form, to confirm your price before we start.

Q: Do you offer same-day junk pickup in Rockford?
A: Yes. First Step Junk Removal offers same-day junk pickup in Rockford, IL and nearby areas when schedule allows. We are open every day from 7:30 AM to 7:30 PM. Call or text (779) 772-1857 to check availability.

Q: What areas do you serve near Rockford?
A: We serve Rockford, Loves Park, Machesney Park, Belvidere, Roscoe, Rockton, Cherry Valley, and the greater Winnebago County area. If you are nearby and unsure, call (779) 772-1857 — we will confirm coverage quickly.

Q: What items will junk removal services not take?
A: We remove household junk, furniture, appliances, electronics, yard waste, construction debris, and other non-hazardous materials. We do not take regulated hazardous waste such as chemicals, paints, oils, asbestos, or medical waste. Ask us if you are unsure about a specific item.

Q: Are you licensed and insured?
A: Yes. FirstStep Junk Removal LLC is licensed and fully insured for residential and commercial work in Rockford, IL. We protect your property with careful handling and provide peace of mind on every job.

Q: How do I get a free junk removal quote?
A: Request a free quote on firststepjunk.com, or call/text (779) 772-1857. Photos of your junk help us price faster. We give transparent, no-obligation estimates — the quote you get is the price you pay.
